Do's

  • Arrive on time and be seated before the conference begins.
  • Sit only in your designated seat unless instructed otherwise.
  • Maintain professional behaviour and respect all speakers and attendees.
  • Keep your mobile phone on silent mode throughout the event.
  • Follow the instructions of the event coordinators at all times.
  • Personal photos may be taken only during designated break times and in approved areas.

Don'ts

  • Do not take photographs or record videos during presentations, speeches, or official sessions.
  • Do not livestream or broadcast any part of the event on social media or any other platform. This is an internal event.
  • Do not share event name, confidential information, presentation materials, or internal discussions outside the organisation or on social media.
  • Do not leave the venue during the event unless you have prior approval or it is an emergency.
  • Do not disrupt the proceedings by talking, making phone calls, or moving around unnecessarily during presentations.

Timing

Event Duration: 9:30 AM – 5:30 PM
